answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Dial painter mainspring assay stamped by the guild warrant. It demands each mainspring is a measured rate sheet plus a master signature, so a farm must paint a hundred real dials by hand, and the ridge is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the dune is that the farm's unit economics never work. The hollow is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
